findings.evidence: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Skeletal.lean:72 `def Skeleton : Type u₁ := InducedCategory (C := Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid C)) C Quotient.out`; :107 `abbrev toSkeleton (X : C) : Skeleton C := ⟦X⟧`; :156 `lemma toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff ... := Quotient.eq` — Mathlib itself applies raw `Quotient` lemmas (`Quotient.eq`, `Quotient.mk_out`, `Quotient.out_eq`, `Quotient.exact`) at `Skeleton C`. TauCeti likewise uses `Quotient.lift`/`Quotient.inductionOn` directly on Mathlib quotient types (TauCeti/Algebra/Group/Conj.lean:73, TauCeti/Algebra/BrauerGroup/Group.lean:145, TauCeti/Algebra/GroupAction/OrbitRelQuotient.lean:70). `Quotient.lift_mk` is core (used at Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Archimedean/Class.lean:222).
findings.fix: Delete the three declarations and call `Quotient.ind` / `Quotient.lift` / `Quotient.lift_mk` directly in their only consumers, `TauCeti.SimpleFDRepClasses.{ind,lift,lift_mk}` (FDRepClasses.lean:85, 93, 105 — that file already has `attribute [local instance] isIsomorphicSetoid` at line 45, and proof irrelevance for the `Simple` field makes `mk X.obj` match `toSkeleton X` exactly as it does today). Keep `ObjectProperty.toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff_nonempty_iso`, which has no Mathlib counterpart.
findings.issue: `Skeleton.ind`, `Skeleton.lift` and `Skeleton.lift_toSkeleton` are core `Quotient.ind`, `Quotient.lift` and `Quotient.lift_mk` restated at `Skeleton C`, which is by definition `Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid C)`; the proofs are `exact Quotient.ind h c`, `Quotient.lift f fun X Y e ↦ h X Y e` (the hypothesis is accepted up to unfolding `IsIsomorphic := Nonempty (X ≅ Y)`), and `simp [lift]`. `lift` is additionally marked `noncomputable`, so it is strictly weaker than what it wraps.

summary: The Simple/IsIrreducible dictionary, the subrepresentation inclusion, and the skeleton of simple objects are absent from Mathlib and from this repository, and each proof reuses located API. The exception is the generic skeleton eliminator/lift, which restates core `Quotient` API under new names.
